summary.decontaminationScope: All selected T2 query/passage bodies and actually used news auxiliary bodies. Sampled campus 64-character sentinels at stride8; complete training scan. Guaranteed detection of >=71 contiguous normalized characters, shorter spans/semantic-only common provenance remain a limitation.
summary.splitPolicy: General 63/7/10/20%, home-campus families 40.5/4.5/15/40%; any overlapping event forced train. Calibration is disjoint from neural training.
